page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 virtual CPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals that the processor performance is generally modest. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Similarly, single-threaded compression and decompression tasks score in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in large-block memory bandwidth reads and writes, as well as in Redis SET operations and small-model LLM inference prompt processing. Passmark CPU tests, including physics and extended instruction sets, also fall within the average range, though database operations and memory scores remain in the lower 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1.2xlarge offers a high memory capacity relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high-frequency CPU performance. The lack of local storage and modest network bandwidth are key tradeoffs to consider. This instance is suitable for memory-cached applications, Redis key-value stores, lightweight database hosting, and general-purpose workloads requiring a larger memory footprint without intensive computational demands.
